mapper.select: SELECT * FROM employee_education ef WHERE ef.employee_id = (SELECT employee_id from employee e where e.employee_no = #{employeeNo})
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_education ( employee_id, entrance_year_month, graduate_year_month, school_name, major_name, degree, graduated, location ) VALUES ( #{employeeId}, #{entranceYearMonth}, #{graduateYearMonth}, #{schoolName}, #{majorName}, #{degree}, #{graduated}, #{location} )
